sql: select sum(f.closing_balance) from gold.ssas_fact_gl_fs_monthly as f inner join (select branch_key, max(month_date_key) as m from gold.ssas_fact_gl_fs_monthly where branch_key between 1 and 8 and month_date_key >= 20260101 and month_date_key <= toYYYYMMDD(today()) group by branch_key) as l on l.branch_key = f.branch_key and l.m = f.month_date_key where f.fs_caption = 'trade receivables, net'

name: FR GL Cutover Difference, branch 2, 2026-08..09 shows the Oasis-to-Fusion gap (review focus 1)
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([FR GL Cutover Difference], Branch[Branch Key] = 2, 'Date'[Year Month] IN {202608, 202609}, 'GL FS Monthly'[FS Caption] = "prepaid expenses and other assets"))
sql: select sumIf(closing_balance, month_date_key = 20260901) - sumIf(opening_balance, month_date_key = 20260801) - sum(opening_journal_amount) - sum(debit) + sum(credit) from gold.ssas_fact_gl_fs_monthly where branch_key = 2 and month_date_key in (20260801, 20260901) and fs_caption = 'prepaid expenses and other assets'

name: FR GL Cutover Difference is blank within one ledger, branch 2, 2026-07..08
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([FR GL Cutover Difference], Branch[Branch Key] = 2, 'Date'[Year Month] IN {202607, 202608}, 'GL FS Monthly'[FS Caption] = "prepaid expenses and other assets"))
sql: select if(abs(x) < 1, 0, x) from (select sumIf(closing_balance, month_date_key = 20260801) - sumIf(opening_balance, month_date_key = 20260701) - sum(opening_journal_amount) - sum(debit) + sum(credit) as x from gold.ssas_fact_gl_fs_monthly where branch_key = 2 and month_date_key in (20260701, 20260801) and fs_caption = 'prepaid expenses and other assets')

name: FR GL Closing Last Year, branch 5, 2026-05 is the May 2025 closing (trade receivables, net)
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([FR GL Closing Last Year], Branch[Branch Key] = 5, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202605, 'GL FS Monthly'[FS Caption] = "trade receivables, net"))
sql: select sum(closing_balance) from gold.ssas_fact_gl_fs_monthly where branch_key = 5 and month_date_key = 20250501 and fs_caption = 'trade receivables, net'

name: FR BS Balance, Current year profit, branch 4, 2026-06 is the net profit of January to June
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([FR BS Balance], Branch[Branch Key] = 4, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202606, 'GL FS Monthly'[BS Caption] = "Current year profit"))
sql: select sum(amount) from gold.ssas_fact_pl_report_monthly where pl_line_code = 'NET_PROFIT' and branch_key = 4 and month_date_key >= 20260101 and month_date_key <= 20260601

name: FR BS Balance, Liabilities & equity, branch 4, 2026-06 carries current year profit, not the IS accounts
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([FR BS Balance], Branch[Branch Key] = 4, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202606, 'GL FS Monthly'[BS Side] = "Liabilities & equity"))
sql: select (select sum(closing_balance * display_sign) from gold.ssas_fact_gl_fs_monthly where branch_key = 4 and month_date_key = 20260601 and bs_side = 'Liabilities & equity' and bs_caption != 'Current year profit') + (select sum(amount) from gold.ssas_fact_pl_report_monthly where pl_line_code = 'NET_PROFIT' and branch_key = 4 and month_date_key >= 20260101 and month_date_key <= 20260601)

name: FR BS Balance, trade receivables, branch 5, 2026-05
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([FR BS Balance], Branch[Branch Key] = 5, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202605, 'GL FS Monthly'[FS Caption] = "trade receivables, net"))
sql: select sum(closing_balance * display_sign) from gold.ssas_fact_gl_fs_monthly where branch_key = 5 and month_date_key = 20260501 and fs_caption = 'trade receivables, net'

name: FR BS Difference, branch 4, 2026-06
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([FR BS Difference], Branch[Branch Key] = 4, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202606))
sql: select if(abs(x) < 1, 0, x) from (select (select sum(closing_balance) from gold.ssas_fact_gl_fs_monthly where branch_key = 4 and month_date_key = 20260601 and bs_side in ('Assets', 'Liabilities & equity') and bs_caption != 'Current year profit') - (select sum(amount) from gold.ssas_fact_pl_report_monthly where pl_line_code = 'NET_PROFIT' and branch_key = 4 and month_date_key >= 20260101 and month_date_key <= 20260601) as x)

name: FR BS Difference, branch 2, 2026-09 shows the not-mapped and cutover gap, whatever row is in context
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([FR BS Difference], Branch[Branch Key] = 2, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202609, 'GL FS Monthly'[BS Side] = "Assets"))
sql: select if(abs(x) < 1, 0, x) from (select (select sum(closing_balance) from gold.ssas_fact_gl_fs_monthly where branch_key = 2 and month_date_key = 20260901 and bs_side in ('Assets', 'Liabilities & equity') and bs_caption != 'Current year profit') - (select sum(amount) from gold.ssas_fact_pl_report_monthly where pl_line_code = 'NET_PROFIT' and branch_key = 2 and month_date_key >= 20260101 and month_date_key <= 20260901) as x)

name: FR BS Budget, trade receivables, branch 1, 2026-06
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([FR BS Budget], Branch[Branch Key] = 1, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202606, 'GL FS Monthly'[FS Caption] = "trade receivables, net"))
sql: select sum(amount) from gold.ssas_fact_finance_budget_monthly where statement = 'BS' and bs_caption = 'trade receivables, net' and branch_key = 1 and month_date_key = 20260601

name: FR BS Budget Label, trade receivables, branch 1, 2026-06 reads No budget yet without a BS budget row
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", IF(CALCULATE([FR BS Budget Label], Branch[Branch Key] = 1, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202606, 'GL FS Monthly'[FS Caption] = "trade receivables, net") = "No budget yet", 1, 0))
sql: select if(count() = 0, 1, 0) from gold.ssas_fact_finance_budget_monthly where statement = 'BS' and bs_caption = 'trade receivables, net' and branch_key = 1 and month_date_key = 20260601

name: FR % of Assets, trade receivables, branch 5, 2026-05
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([FR % of Assets], Branch[Branch Key] = 5, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202605, 'GL FS Monthly'[FS Caption] = "trade receivables, net"))
sql: select toFloat64((select sum(closing_balance * display_sign) from gold.ssas_fact_gl_fs_monthly where branch_key = 5 and month_date_key = 20260501 and fs_caption = 'trade receivables, net')) / toFloat64((select sum(closing_balance * display_sign) from gold.ssas_fact_gl_fs_monthly where branch_key = 5 and month_date_key = 20260501 and fs_element = 'assets'))

name: FR Period Debits, branch 1, 2025-12 is the whole ledger whatever row is in context
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([FR Period Debits], Branch[Branch Key] = 1, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202512, 'GL FS Monthly'[FS Caption] = "trade receivables, net"))
sql: select sum(debit) from gold.ssas_fact_gl_fs_monthly where branch_key = 1 and month_date_key = 20251201

name: FR Period Credits, branch 1, 2025-12
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([FR Period Credits], Branch[Branch Key] = 1, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202512))
sql: select sum(credit) from gold.ssas_fact_gl_fs_monthly where branch_key = 1 and month_date_key = 20251201

name: FR Out of Balance, branch 1, 2025-12
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([FR Out of Balance], Branch[Branch Key] = 1, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202512))
sql: select sum(debit) - sum(credit) from gold.ssas_fact_gl_fs_monthly where branch_key = 1 and month_date_key = 20251201

name: FR Net Working Capital, branch 5, 2026-05
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([FR Net Working Capital], Branch[Branch Key] = 5, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202605))
sql: select sumIf(closing_balance * display_sign, fs_category = 'current assets') - sumIf(closing_balance * display_sign, fs_category = 'current liabilities') from gold.ssas_fact_gl_fs_monthly where branch_key = 5 and month_date_key = 20260501

name: FR BS Last Year, trade receivables, branch 5, 2026-05 is the May 2025 balance
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([FR BS Last Year], Branch[Branch Key] = 5, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202605, 'GL FS Monthly'[FS Caption] = "trade receivables, net"))
sql: select sum(closing_balance * display_sign) from gold.ssas_fact_gl_fs_monthly where branch_key = 5 and month_date_key = 20250501 and fs_caption = 'trade receivables, net'

name: FR BS Last Year, Current year profit, branch 4, 2026-06 is the net profit of January to June 2025
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([FR BS Last Year], Branch[Branch Key] = 4, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202606, 'GL FS Monthly'[BS Caption] = "Current year profit"))
sql: select sum(amount) from gold.ssas_fact_pl_report_monthly where pl_line_code = 'NET_PROFIT' and branch_key = 4 and month_date_key >= 20250101 and month_date_key <= 20250601

name: FR BS Balance (Budgeted), trade receivables, all hospitals, 2026-06 adds only the hospitals with a BS budget
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([FR BS Balance (Budgeted)], Branch[Branch Key] IN {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8}, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202606, 'GL FS Monthly'[FS Caption] = "trade receivables, net"))
sql: select sum(closing_balance * display_sign) from gold.ssas_fact_gl_fs_monthly where month_date_key = 20260601 and fs_caption = 'trade receivables, net' and branch_key between 1 and 8 and branch_key in (select branch_key from gold.ssas_fact_finance_budget_monthly where statement = 'BS' and bs_caption = 'trade receivables, net' and month_date_key = 20260601)
